SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM note_chunk c JOIN note n ON n.id=c.note_id AND n.owner_id=c.owner_id WHERE c.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND n.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND n.status='READY' AND c.embedding_model != #{embeddingModel} AND n.id IN #{id})
